title: Groq raises $350M to fuel its pivot from AI chips to neocloud | TechCrunch
summary: After it lost its star team, Groq shifted from being a pure AI chipmaker into a cloud and data center provider that operates Nvidia systems, making the remaining Groq company an Nvidia customer.
